title: Chapter 135 What To Do
content:
Chapter 135 What To Do

Standing in the void, Lu Daosheng recalled the past scenes with Yan Lingyun, and suddenly he couldn't help but smile.

And the Tiandao of the Wood Immortal Realm beside him was trembling all over.

He was afraid that Lu Daosheng would blame him for watching Yan Lingyun die.

Looking at Lu Daosheng's expression, he could guess the relationship between the woman and the extremely terrifying existence in front of him.

Although it had nothing to do with him, it was not his fault.

But strong people of this level are usually moody. When getting along with each other, if you are not careful, you may not know how you died.

Just like himself, as the supreme existence of the Wood Immortal Realm, facing some weak ants in the Wood Immortal Realm, their life and death are worthless in his eyes.

I don't know how long it took, Lu Daosheng finally came back to his senses.

Looking at the trembling Tiandao on the side, Lu Daosheng waved to Tiandao.

"Go away, there's nothing for you to do."

Hearing this, Tiandao heaved a sigh of relief.

"Goodbye, boss. If you need anything, just let me know."

After saying this, Tiandao disappeared without a trace.

At the original place, Lu Daosheng stood in the void.

Although Yan Lingyun didn't stay in the Wood Immortal Realm for a long time, she basically didn't do anything else.

Except for using her spare time to teach an apprentice.

After a moment of silence, Lu Daosheng's figure trembled and disappeared directly from the original place.

In a forbidden area in the Wood Immortal Realm.

A woman with a messy figure, who could still be seen faintly, was lying on an altar.

There were several huge stone pillars standing around.

A chain extended from each of them, entwining the woman on the altar.

It was covered with powerful sealing power.

At this time, crisp footsteps suddenly sounded from a distance.

The next moment, the woman suddenly stood up, her deep eyes looking into the distance, trying to see the identity of the target.

In just a moment, a man had already walked to the edge of the altar.

Seeing the man, the woman frowned slightly.

"Aren't you afraid of me?"

At this time, Lu Daosheng was still looking at the woman on the altar.

The chain locked the woman tightly, making it impossible for her to step out of the altar.

This is the disciple that Yan Lingyun taught on a whim in the Wood Immortal Realm, Wanfeng.

At the beginning, Wanfeng took the initiative to find Yan Lingyun and begged Yan Lingyun for a long time. In the end, Yan Lingyun saw that he had good talent and her injuries could not be recovered for a while, so she simply accepted Wanfeng as her disciple.

And Wanfeng did not live up to her training, and soon became a powerful man in the Wood Immortal Realm.

Later, Wanfeng broke through the Immortal Emperor and became the fastest and youngest Immortal Emperor in the Wood Immortal Realm in several eras.

The world only knows that Wan Feng has a terrifying talent, but they don't know the identity of the person behind him.

Until Yan Lingyun got into trouble.

That day, Wan Feng saw his master die with his own eyes.

In an instant, a force that even he could not control surged out of his body.

The terrifying power continued to pour down, and countless forces were affected.

In the end, under the joint efforts of nine long-established immortal emperors, he was sealed here at the cost of one death and seven injuries.

And Wan Feng also got a title.

Crazy Emperor.

Since then, there has been another life forbidden area in the Wood Immortal Realm.

Every once in a while, the uncontrollable power in Wan Feng's body will run wild. Now, under the influence of many years, this place has become the most terrifying forbidden area in the Wood Immortal Realm.

The reason why the nine immortal emperors chose to seal Wan Feng and did not kill her was because of the power in Wan Feng's body.

Once Wan Feng died, that power would probably riot because of the loss of its host, and the powerful power would even destroy half of the Wood Immortal Realm.

And all this was told to them by Tian Dao.

"The power of taboo."

At this time, Lu Daosheng looked at Wan Feng on the altar and spoke slowly.

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, Wan Feng's pupils shrank sharply, "You, you know this power?"

A pale white power condensed from his palm.

Suddenly, the surrounding space was completely corrupted, and it was obviously unable to withstand this power.

Seeing this scene, Lu Daosheng nodded slightly. That's right, it was indeed the power of taboo.

Unexpectedly, this legendary power would appear here.

No wonder Wan Feng went berserk back then. This kind of power beyond the rules and extremely domineering, Wan Feng's mind was not completely swallowed up by this power, which was already against the sky.

"Do you know who I am?"

Lu Daosheng smiled faintly.

Looking at Lu Daosheng, Wan Feng shook her head. She was 100% sure that this was the first time she had seen Lu Daosheng.

"Yan Lingyun is my wife."

Lu Daosheng said.

Hearing this, Wan Feng's expression suddenly became a little gloomy.

"Are you kidding? Do you know who my master is?"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng did not say any extra nonsense, but just raised his hand, and Yan Lingyun's figure gradually condensed.

When he saw Yan Lingyun's figure clearly, Wan Feng's eyes suddenly became extremely red.

"Master,"

Buzz——

In an instant, the terrifying forbidden power ran wild again, Wan Feng's eyes suddenly turned pale white, and Wan Feng's breath began to surge continuously, the void was turbulent, and it seemed like a scene of destroying the world.

Looking at Wan Feng who was on the verge of losing his will, Lu Daosheng did not change his face and threw out a talisman casually.

The next moment, the talisman shocked the entire space, including Wan Feng.

After an unknown amount of time, Wan Feng gradually came to his senses.

Looking at Lu Daosheng again, Wan Feng's expression was no longer as hostile as at the beginning, but he was still very alert.

"You said you are my master's man?"

Wan Feng asked.

Lu Daosheng nodded, "Yes."

"How do you prove it?"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng immediately laughed.

How to prove it? Should I show you the marriage certificate?

"Do you really want to get out?"

I told you so much because I wanted to save you. If you were not my wife's apprentice, I would not even bother to look at you.

On the altar, Wan Feng was silent for a moment and nodded.

"Then don't ask so many questions."

Lu Daosheng said in a light voice.

Then, Lu Daosheng clenched his fists tightly, and in an instant, the surrounding space was completely shattered.

Boom!

Accompanied by a terrifying explosion.

The entire seal formation suddenly shattered.

There are many ways to break the seal, but violence is often the easiest.

At the same time, several forces in the Wood Immortal Realm were shaken.

Countless powerful divine consciousnesses probed towards a forbidden area in the Wood Immortal Realm.

Feeling the familiar and terrifying aura, several powerful beings suddenly looked tense.

Did the Crazy Emperor break the seal?

Back then, the nine immortal emperors worked together to seal the Crazy Emperor, and it was because Wan Feng had been affected by the power of the taboo at that time that they were able to successfully seal him.

As time passed, only three of the nine immortal emperors are still alive.

There are only five of the nine forces corresponding to them.

Now if the Crazy Emperor retaliates against them, it will be really dangerous.

On Xuanding Mountain.

A top force, Xuanzong, is standing here.

At this time, in the deepest part of the sect, an old man with a bleak expression looked a little gloomy.

"Ancestor, what can we do?"

A middle-aged man looked at the old man with a sad face.
